title: Royal Smash! - Physics Puzzle
notes:
Welcome Back gifts are here!: Been away for a while? Come back to a stack of coins, unlimited lives and boosters waiting for you.

Hold to See the Table: Out of moves? Press and hold to look at the table before you decide whether to keep going.

Fresh look: New booster icons, a redesigned Power Play start screen and updated wood textures.

Level updates: New levels, smoother difficulty across many existing ones, and better multi-stage levels.
